name: app-6ab39ebd0be081918f0d809733bcf984
description: Plan, review, generate, schedule, and publish SEO content with RankOrg.

interface.longDescription: RankOrg helps businesses, SaaS companies, and marketing teams plan and publish SEO content from a topical map. Review site context, content schedules, article drafts, search performance, and keyword coverage. Research keywords, generate and schedule articles, edit content, and reschedule planned posts. Publish or consolidate articles after explicit confirmation. Search performance requires a connected Google Search Console property.
defaultPrompt: Review my topical map and identify gaps in keyword coverage.
Show my upcoming content schedule and article drafts.
Review my search performance and suggest content priorities.

positive.description: Active test account with planned and generated upcoming articles.
positive.prompt: Review my business context and upcoming article schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getSiteContext then listContent with filter=scheduled; summarize only returned titles, statuses and dates.

positive.description: Active test account with a populated topical map.
positive.prompt: Which topic clusters have gaps in keyword coverage?
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned topical-map clusters and coverage; distinguish planned, generated and published coverage without invented metrics.

positive.description: Active test account; connect Search Console to test metrics, or explicitly test disconnected recovery.
positive.prompt: How is my site performing in Google Search?
positive.expected_behavior: Report returned metrics and period; if Search Console is disconnected explain the connection requirement without fabricated data.

positive.description: Dedicated active test account with company profile, topical map and an open publishing slot; generation modifies test data.
positive.prompt: Research keywords for my business and generate the next article.
positive.expected_behavior: Research from the account business profile, then generate the next priority article and report returned schedule. Respect an existing-upcoming-article result rather than claiming a new article.

positive.description: Dedicated test tenant with a generated scheduled article and disposable public destination. Tester must explicitly confirm publication in a second message.
positive.prompt: Show me a scheduled article and help me publish it now.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify a scheduled article using returned id and inspect it. Ask explicit confirmation of the title and destination before publishContent(id). After tester confirms, report only returned success; otherwise do not publish.

negative.description: Explain that RankOrg has no billing-administration tool; direct the user to RankOrg without invoking write tools.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my RankOrg subscription and charge my credit card.

negative.description: Explain the account boundary and lack of ownership-transfer tools; do not request credentials or invoke mutation tools.

review.commerce_description: Subscriptions are purchased and managed in the RankOrg web app outside ChatGPT. MCP tools expose no pricing, checkout, payment processing, or subscription-management actions.

publication.release_notes: Corrected MCP tool annotations to match account writes, keyword replacement, public website access, and live redirect changes. Added per-tool annotation justifications. The latest supplied scan shows rescheduleContent with readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=true, and openWorldHint=false; this tool update awaits further review before going live.
